readme: The brand kit — everything a renderer needs to produce an on-brand asset without a human re-explaining the brand. Git-tracked JSON on purpose: the site imports it statically (a commit redeploys the showroom) and scripts/media-brief.mjs compiles it into prompts. Three renderers consume it: the `chatgpt` seat lane (a human pastes the compiled prompt into ChatGPT), the `higgs` CLI lane, and the deterministic `template` lane (the carousel engine). One kit, three lanes — so a brand change lands everywhere at once.

chatgpt.label: ChatGPT seat (GPT-5.6 Sol → GPT Image 2)
chatgpt.why: Sol is a reasoning model with text output; it renders pictures by calling the image tool, which is GPT Image 2. A ChatGPT plan is not API access — there is no key, so no server can call this lane. The seat is a renderer, not an endpoint: kun compiles the prompt, a human pastes it, kun ingests the file back.
chatgpt.sizeRule: GPT Image 2 takes arbitrary WIDTHxHEIGHT, not a fixed enum, subject to four constraints (verified against the official image-generation guide, 2026-08-05): both edges divisible by 16, longest edge <= 3840, long:short ratio <= 3:1, and total pixels between 655,360 and 8,294,400. The pixel FLOOR is the one that bites — 1200x624 clears it at 748,800, but a smaller plate would be rejected. Every size in `types` below satisfies all four; do not round them by hand, and check the floor before adding a type.

higgs.label: Higgsfield CLI
higgs.why: Paid credits, unattended, best for cinematic photography and the only lane that does video. Model/ratio tables live in /docs/media.

template.label: Carousel engine (HTML → PNG)
template.why: Anything carrying copy. Real Thmanyah type, exact platform pixels, no typography risk. See /docs/social/carousel.

hogwarts.note: The media brand is Hogwarts (Abdout, 2026-08-05). The shipped app introduces itself to schools as بالقلم / balqalam — that is the in-product name, deliberately not the media name. Do not let a generated asset say بالقلم unless someone changes this line.
hogwarts.what: A multi-tenant school management system — admissions, timetable, attendance, exams, grades, finance — sold to schools across MENA.
hogwarts.audience: School owners and principals in Sudan, Saudi Arabia and the UAE. They are administrators, not technologists: the promise is relief from paperwork, not software features.
hogwarts.tone: Calm, exact, unhurried. Never playful, never salesy, never 'edtech startup'. The visual argument is competence.

mark.describe: A single quill — one upright feather leaning to the right, solid black silhouette, with one carved white stroke running the length of the vane and a fine tapering tail at the base. Transparent background.
mark.meaning: The pen. It is what بالقلم means, and it is why the mark is a quill rather than a building or a graduation cap.
rules: The mark is placed in post, never drawn by a generative model — an AI-drawn approximation of a logo is a different logo.
Monochrome ink only. It inverts to ivory on the dark and clay canvases; it is never recolored to an accent.
Attach it as a reference image on every ChatGPT render so the scene is composed with room for it, then place the real file on top.

typography.license: Embedding and commercial use permitted; redistribution is not. Files are fetched by scripts/fetch-thmanyah.mjs on predev/prebuild and never committed or served from the CDN.

arabicHeadline.why: The signature calligraphic look — this pairing is the brand's voice in Arabic.

rules: Arabic never takes letter-spacing — it breaks the connected script.
Arabic is the first-class language; English mirrors it. RTL is the default direction.
Type is set by the template lane, never by a generative model.

palette.why: Drawn from the Anthropic catalog (src/components/root/anthropic/data.ts) so slides, site and generated media share one set of values. Quote the hex to a renderer — a color name alone drifts.
rules: One accent per image. Clay carries the emphasis; everything else is neutral.
No gradients, no glow, no neon. Saturation stays low — the warm neutrals do the work.
Never the stock-edtech palette: no royal blue, no purple-to-pink gradient, no lime green.

minimal.use: hero, product, mockup, og and banner plates, anything documentary
minimal.prompt: Editorial minimalism. Generous negative space, one clear subject, flat even light, no gradients or drop shadows, restrained warm-neutral palette, composed with a calm horizon and room at the bottom-start corner for a mark to be placed in post.

cinematic.use: lifestyle, story, reel stills, anything with people
cinematic.prompt: Documentary photography. Natural window light, shallow depth of field, muted warm grade, candid unposed moment, real classroom or office texture, no studio lighting rig, no lens flare.

subjectLibrary.why: The scenes that actually read as this product. Reach for these before inventing one.
items: A school administrator at a desk with an open laptop, paper registers stacked and closed beside it
An empty classroom in early morning light, chairs squared to the desks
A parent's hands holding a phone, a school corridor soft behind
A teacher walking a corridor with a tablet, students blurred in motion
A school front office counter, clean and unhurried, no queue
Close detail of an attendance register, warm daylight raking across the page

negative.why: The list that separates a usable render from a discard. Every item here has cost us a generation at least once.
items: no text, no lettering, no numerals, no signage, no UI labels — Arabic script in particular renders as nonsense
no logos, no watermarks, no brand marks of any kind
no Harry Potter or wizarding references — the repo is named hogwarts, the product is not
no Western-school stock clichés: no yellow school bus, no red apple on a desk, no chalkboard with equations, no graduation caps thrown in the air
no AI-glossy skin, no plastic sheen, no over-sharpened HDR
no blue-to-purple tech gradient, no neon, no dark 'dashboard' UI glow
no cluttered collage; one subject, one idea

region.why: The single most common failure is a render that looks like a suburban American school.
items: MENA setting — Sudanese, Saudi or Emirati school interiors
Modest dress read as ordinary, not as a costume; hijab where natural, never as the subject of the image
Warm daylight, plastered or painted walls, ceiling fans, simple wooden or steel furniture
Mixed ages of building — these are working schools, not architectural showpieces

documentary_calm.use: reels and video showcases (Seedance 2.5 and Veo)
documentary_calm.prompt: Documentary 24fps cinematography. A quiet morning administrative office or classroom in a Khartoum or Riyadh school. Smooth slow tracking push-in with 35mm shallow depth of field. Soft raking morning sunlight through sheer blinds. Audio: Gentle morning breeze, quiet footsteps in hallway, soft paper rustle.

lifestyle.use: people-in-context scenes for ads and posts

product.use: the physical world around the product — desks, registers, devices

mockup.use: a device in a scene; the screen is left blank and composited in post
mockup.extra: The screen must be blank, off, or a flat neutral rectangle — never a rendered interface.

plate.use: a text-free background plate the template lane sets copy over for og and banner
plate.extra: Compose as a background: keep the centre and the start edge quiet so a headline can sit there.

og.use: carries copy — renders on the carousel engine

logo.use: the mark exists; it is never regenerated

mkan.note: Mkan (مكان) — Port Sudan short-term home rental marketplace (and intercity transport). Honest, high-fidelity Airbnb adaptation for Port Sudan, Red Sea State, Sudan.
mkan.what: A Port Sudan short-term home rental marketplace — coastal apartments, furnished family houses, Red Sea view verandas — with contact-first host connection (and intercity bus ticketing) across Sudan.
mkan.audience: Travelers, families, and professionals seeking clean, reliable short stays in Port Sudan (B2C); local home hosts listing properties with direct phone contact and instant availability confirmation (B2B).
mkan.tone: Warm, honest, hospitable, coastal calm. Direct 1:1 Airbnb mirror aesthetic localized to Port Sudan.

mark.describe: A stylized architectural archway and destination pin silhouette in monochrome ink.
mark.meaning: Place, destination, Sudanese hospitality and home.
rules: The mark is placed in post, never drawn by a generative model.
Monochrome ink only. Inverts to ivory on dark and terracotta canvases.
Leave room at the bottom-start corner for the mark and mkan.sd lockup.
Arabic is first-class; English mirrors it.

palette.why: Red Sea coastal blues, warm desert dune neutrals, terracotta accent, and slate dark matching Airbnb warmth in a Port Sudan context.

canvas.name: Slate Dark
canvas.use: dark coastal evening canvas; ink on light

canvas.name: Clay
canvas.use: the one accent — brand coral terracotta

rules: One accent per image. Coral Terracotta carries the emphasis; coastal neutrals do the work.
No neon, no oversaturated AI gradients. Natural coastal daylight and Red Sea sunset light only.

minimal.use: hero, product, mockup, listing detail plates
minimal.prompt: Architectural minimalism. Clean lines, ceramic tile floors, whitewashed plaster, generous negative space, bright natural seaside daylight, room at bottom-start for mkan.sd brand mark.

cinematic.use: lifestyle, story, reel stills, candid guest scenes
cinematic.prompt: Cinematic documentary photography. Natural coastal window light, shallow depth of field, warm color grade, candid unposed moments of Sudanese hospitality in Port Sudan.

coastal_red_sea.use: Port Sudan seaside apartments, veranda views
coastal_red_sea.prompt: Coastal architectural photography. A modern furnished Port Sudan apartment overlooking the Red Sea, light airy linen curtains moving in sea breeze, warm sunset glow.

airbnb_made_possible.prompt: Documentary home photography. Warm candid moments of friends or family enjoying tea on a balcony in Port Sudan, natural unposed laughter, authentic home comfort.

made_possible_by_host.use: Airbnb 'Made possible by Hosts' mirror reels (Seedance 2.5 / Veo)
made_possible_by_host.prompt: Documentary 24fps cinematography. A warm candid morning in a sunlit coastal apartment in Port Sudan. A Sudanese family enjoying fresh mint tea on a breezy tiled balcony overlooking the calm Red Sea coastline at golden hour. Gentle handheld drift, 35mm natural optics. Audio: Gentle coastal breeze, faint clink of tea glasses, quiet warm laughter.

coastal_walkthrough.use: Property showcase reels, Seedance 2.5 and Veo video
coastal_walkthrough.prompt: Cinematic 24fps architectural video. Slow smooth gimbal glide through a bright living room in Port Sudan (Hayy Al-Shati) out onto an open terrace overlooking the harbor at sunset. Audio: Soft Red Sea waves, gentle breeze, calm room ambience.

subjectLibrary.why: The scenes that actually represent Mkan in Port Sudan.
items: A bright, clean living room in a furnished apartment in Port Sudan (Hayy Al-Shati) with sea breeze through sheer curtains
A family sharing fresh mint tea on a breezy tiled balcony overlooking the Red Sea coast at sunset
A modern, well-equipped kitchen in a Salbona rental apartment with clean ceramic countertops and morning light
A tranquil bedroom in an Al-Riyadh Port Sudan home with crisp white bedding, wooden nightstand, and soft lamp glow
Detail of a guest receiving host keys and verified contact card on a dining table with fresh tea glasses
An open veranda terrace in an Airport District home overlooking Port Sudan palms and twilight sky
A spacious living hall with comfortable traditional modern seating, ceiling fan gently spinning, and natural daylight
A traveler working on a laptop at a neat wooden desk in a quiet Port Sudan rental flat

negative.why: Negative prompt bank to eliminate common AI video and image rendering defects.
items: no text, no lettering, no numerals, no signage, no UI labels
no logos, no watermarks, no brand marks of any kind
no Western suburban houses, no American McMansions, no snow or pine trees
no distorted perspective, no impossible architectural geometry, no warped furniture
no AI-glossy skin, no plastic sheen, no over-saturated HDR
no cluttered chaotic rooms, no messy luggage; one pristine, welcoming home

region.why: Regional authenticity for Port Sudan and Red Sea coastal settings.
items: Port Sudan, Sudan setting — Red Sea coastal districts (Hayy Al-Shati, Salbona, Al-Riyadh, Airport District)
Authentic Sudanese hospitality decor — airy curtains, clean tile floors, comfortable seating, ceiling fans, tea glasses
Modest, natural Sudanese attire; authentic and unforced
Warm golden hour seaside light and bright natural coastal daylight
